summary: TH International Limited (Tims China), a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K announcing the September 10, 2026 closing of the second tranche of Senior Secured Convertible Notes due 2029 issued to Tim Hortons Restaurants International GmbH. Principal was US$14,539,026.00, with total proceeds including accrued interest of US$15 million. The notes consolidate and rank pari passu with the existing floating-rate senior secured convertible notes due 2029. Two further tranches are expected, with the final tranche targeted for the first quarter of 2027. This is a routine financing drawdown, not a special situation; watch dilution and the secured overhang.
